itens.titulo: Elon Musk Teases Tesla Merger and $1 Trillion Milestone for SpaceX
itens.descricao: Elon Musk Teases Tesla Merger and $1 Trillion Milestone for SpaceX Yahoo Finance
trechos: Elon Musk said SpaceX could reach a $500 billion to $1 trillion annual recurring revenue (ARR) run rate by 2027.
Musk's Response to Surprise Q3 Earnings Annual recurring revenue (ARR) is the yearly value of recurring revenue, usually estimated by annualizing a current period.
The range Musk gave runs from $500 billion to $1 trillion by the end of 2027.
Any deal would require approval from at least 50% of Tesla shareholders, which Musk called a high hurdle.
A combined company would be valued at roughly $2 trillion for SpaceX and $1.5 trillion for Tesla.
SpaceX posted third-quarter revenue of $14.6 billion, up 161% YoY, beating analyst estimates.
Net income reached $4.4 billion, reversing a $1.1 billion loss.
Super Intelligence revenue rose 830% to $7.56 billion, making it the main engine of growth.

itens.titulo: Nvidia unveils DSX POD, a data center about the size of a shipping container
itens.descricao: Nvidia unveils DSX POD, a data center about the size of a shipping container Yahoo Finance
trechos: According to Nvidia, the Vera Rubin-powered DSX PODs will arrive on site, ready to be plugged into the power, cooling, and networking infrastructure, reducing deployment time from six months to 14 days.
According to the company, the DSX POD supports liquid cooling, but because it uses dry-cooler designs, it can save up to 54 million liters of water per day versus a standard data center.
Nvidia says it's working with partners including Anduril, Armada, Bull, Crusoe, Dell Technologies (DELL), Foxconn, and others to begin delivering the DSX POD in early 2027.

itens.titulo: Bitcoin risk management grows more popular as the 'just bet on price' era fades
itens.descricao: Bitcoin risk management grows more popular as the 'just bet on price' era fades CoinDesk
trechos: According to Volmex, the issuer of the bitcoin volatility index BVIV, options accounted for just under 60% of open interest among all bitcoin derivatives last week.
That’s up from around 50% at the start of the year.
bitcoin exchange-traded funds had about $36 billion in open interest, with BlackRock’s IBIT accounting for nearly $35 billion of the total.
Add in options on crypto-native platforms, and the figure rises to roughly $76 billion.
When bitcoin futures, including perpetual futures and dated contracts, are taken into account, the overall market reaches about $129 billion.
ETF options alone are now about 47% of the bitcoin options market, which is mainly owned by Deribit.
IBIT options have tripled since January 2025, when open interest was about $11 billion.
equities, where options tied to the S&P 500 Index accounted for nearly 75% of all derivatives linked to the index and index equivalents as of last year.

itens.titulo: Pesquisa Quaest aparece em dia mais esvaziado e investidores monitoram balanços; Ibovespa em dólar cai nesta quarta-feira (21)
itens.descricao: Pesquisa Quaest aparece em dia mais esvaziado e investidores monitoram balanços; Ibovespa em dólar cai nesta quarta-feira (21) Money Times
itens.texto:
Pesquisa Quaest aparece em dia mais esvaziado e investidores monitoram balanços; Ibovespa em dólar cai nesta quarta-feira (21)
Os investidores encaram uma quarta-feira (21) bastante árida no campo de indicadores e eventos.
Assim, as atenções se voltam para a nova rodada da pesquisa Quaest para o segundo turno das eleições, que acontece no próximo domingo (25).
Vale lembrar que, segundo os levantamentos, o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) e o atual presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) seguem empatados dentro da margem de erro e qualquer mudança para um lado ou para o outro tende a mexer com a bolsa brasileira.
Por fim, a temporada de balanços também chama a atenção nesta quarta-feira. O guidance (projeção) mais fraco da Netflix (NFLX) fez com que os papéis recuassem mais de 6% no pré-mercado, enquanto as receitas mais fortes da SpaceX (SPCX) animaram os investidores, que operam com as ações em alta de 5%hoje.
Mercado brasileiro
Ibovespa: O Ibovespa (IBOV) recuperou as perdas da véspera e ganhou fôlego com entrada de capital estrangeiro e ajuste de posições a cinco dias do segundo turno das eleições presidenciais.
Nesta terça-feira (20), o principal índice da bolsa brasileira terminou as negociações com alta de 1,57%, aos 208.295,98 pontos.
Já o dólar à vista encerrou as negociações a R$ 5,0183, com queda de 0,58%.
O iShares MSCI Brazil (EWZ) — principal ETF brasileiro negociado em Nova York — cai 0,14%, cotado a US$ 42,88.
Mercados internacionais
As bolsas asiáticas fecharam o pregão com viés majoritariamente negativo. Na Europa, os principais índices começam o dia em alta e os futuros de Nova York sobem hoje.
- Petróleo: Os preços do petróleo sobem hoje.
- Criptomoedas: O mercado de criptomoedas sobe hoje.

- 10h — Evento – Anúncio das Iniciativas relacionadas à imunidade tributária de itens destinados à pesquisa científica e tecnológica em Instituições Científica Tecnológicas e de Inovação (ICTs) públicas

itens.titulo: Is Bitcoin on the Verge of a Deeper Correction? The S&P 500 May Hold the Answer
itens.descricao: Is Bitcoin on the Verge of a Deeper Correction? The S&P 500 May Hold the Answer Yahoo Finance
trechos: Bitcoin is consolidating near $82,000 to $83,000 after retreating from recent highs above $87,000.
A new CryptoQuant analysis warns that the S&P 500 is showing similar weakness.
Why Bitcoin and the S&P 500 Are Moving Together The CryptoQuant analysis by nocoffeenobrain notes concurrent weakness in Bitcoin and the S&P 500.
10-year Treasury yields are pushing toward multi-year highs while momentum fades in both markets.
Historical parallels include late 2018 and January to April 2025.
In late 2018, yields rolled over from their peaks, equities came under pressure, and Bitcoin's sell-off intensified into year-end.
In 2025, yields retreated from January highs before April turmoil hit both equities and Bitcoin.
The S&P 500 has yet to experience a proper correction this cycle.
